name: Giuseppe Verdi
summary: Dynamic and results-driven Sales Manager with over 8 years of experience in managing direct sales teams and driving revenue growth. Proven track record in developing successful sales strategies while fostering relationships with clients and stakeholders.

description: Led a team of 15 sales representatives to exceed quarterly sales targets by 25%.
Developed and implemented a new sales strategy that increased market penetration by 30%.
Trained new hires and provided ongoing coaching to sales team members.
Achieved 150% of sales targets in 2018 through effective client engagement.
Collaborated with marketing teams to align initiatives with sales objectives.
Conducted market research to identify new potential clients and market opportunities.
